name: software-workflows
description: Agent-teams orchestration with Codex as the cross-model advisor and writer: the Codex Oracle MCP server (architect_review, code_review, research, codex_query, abraham and its run tools) and the hooks that gate plan mode and git push on a Codex review.

office.title: Codex Office: when to show it
office.description: The Codex Office is the live pixel view of your Codex runs, in your browser at http://127.0.0.1:8765/; watching it costs no tokens. open (default): start it the first time a session uses a Codex tool, and open it in your browser once per session. background: start it the same way, but never open the browser. off: never start it automatically; /software-workflows:office still starts it. The SOFTWARE_WORKFLOWS_OFFICE environment variable, when set, overrides this for the sessions that have it.

writer_mcp_servers.title: Writer MCP servers
writer_mcp_servers.description: Writer MCP servers: all (default), or a JSON list of exact server names. Changes apply at the next coordinator start.

writer_park_idle_seconds.title: Writer idle parking delay
writer_park_idle_seconds.description: Seconds of native inactivity before verified unload and parking. Default 1800; 0 disables idle-timer parking (memory pressure can still park a writer). SOFTWARE_WORKFLOWS_WRITER_PARK_IDLE_SECONDS overrides this setting.

memory_warn_ratio.title: Memory compression warning ratio
memory_warn_ratio.description: Pause new native launches at this compressor ratio; kernel warning pressure alone parks idle writers without pausing launches. Default 0.50; must be below the critical ratio.

memory_critical_ratio.title: Memory compression critical ratio
memory_critical_ratio.description: Refuse new native launches at this compressor ratio, or kernel critical pressure. Default 0.62.
